newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ASX substantial shareholding notices - April 8.
newsitem.headline: ASX substantial shareholding notices - April 8.

text.p: The following substantial shareholder notices have been made to The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).
Pivot Nutrition Pty Limited increased its relevant interest in Gibson's Limited on 07/04/1997, from 4,361,906 ordinary shares (95.41%) to 4,546,557 ordinary shares (99.45%).
Jetsin Pty Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Coffey International Limited on 03/04/1997.
Permanent Trustee Company Ltd increased its relevant interest in Cinema Plus Limited on 03/01/1997, from 8,617,789 ordinary shares (11.49%) to 9,934,289 ordinary shares (13.25%).
SHL Pty Ltd ceased to be a substantial shareholder in Australian Gold Fields NL on 02/04/1997.
NRMA Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Pacific BBA Limited on 02/04/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 6,814,440 ordinary shares (5.24%).

Permanent Trustee Company Limited increased its relevant interest in Amalgamated Holdings Limited on 02/04/1997, from 2,181,657 ordinary shares (7.70%) to 10,331,823 ordinary shares (8.89%). Note: There was a 3:1 bonus issue in October 1996.
TL Technology Research Pty Ltd increased its relevant interest in Intag International Limited on 12/03/1997, from 10,790,000 ordinary shares (14.9%) to 13,790,000 ordinary shares (18.4%).
Forestbrook Pty Limited became a substantial shareholder in Ausfor Limited on 31/03/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 4,762,942 ordinary shares (68.3%).
Ballyshaw Pty Ltd & N J Miles became a substantial shareholder in Maxilink Limited on 07/04/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 5,603,700 ordinary shares (5.6%).
AMP Society became a substantial shareholder in Macmahon Holdings Limited on 03/04/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 8,553,798 ordinary shares (5.53%).

Metallic Resources Pty Ltd became a substantial shareholder in Golden Cross Resources NL on 20/02/1997 with a relevant interest in the issued ordinary share capital of 3,900,000 ordinary shares (10.09%).
